about.metadataTitle: About Comrade Sovia — Music, Art & Storytelling
about.metadataDescription: Discover Comrade Sovia, an independent music and visual art project by Mikatsuki Runa, its Soviet-inspired arrangements and fictional radio world.
about.title: About Comrade Sovia
about.lead: Comrade Sovia is an independent music and visual art project created by Mikatsuki Runa. It reinterprets music from different cultures and eras through Soviet-inspired arrangements, visual aesthetics, and fictional storytelling.
worldParagraphs: At the center of the project is Sovia Rabocheva (Совия Ивановна Рабочева), an original fictional character who works as a radio broadcaster in the Soviet scientific town of Troitsk.

In Sovia’s fictional universe, an unusual phenomenon allows music from other worlds to reach her radio station. She collects these unfamiliar melodies and reinterprets them through the musical traditions of her own world, sharing them with listeners through her broadcasts.
directionParagraphs: The project’s music draws inspiration from Soviet orchestral arrangements, choral traditions, folk music, vintage recordings, and theatrical performances. Its visual identity combines Soviet-era design influences with anime-inspired character art.

Comrade Sovia blends musical experimentation, creative reinterpretation, fictional worldbuilding, humor, and occasional satire. It is an independent artistic project rather than a historical reconstruction or a representation of any political organization.
about.distinction: Comrade Sovia is the project. Mikatsuki Runa is its real-world creator. Sovia Rabocheva is a fictional character within its story.

creator.metadataTitle: Mikatsuki Runa — Creator of Comrade Sovia
creator.metadataDescription: Meet Mikatsuki Runa, the Germany-based independent creator of Comrade Sovia, and learn how music, visual art and fiction come together in the project.
creator.title: Mikatsuki Runa
creator.lead: Mikatsuki Runa is the stage name of an independent creator based in Germany and the creator of Comrade Sovia.
paragraphs: With a personal passion for singing and music, Runa enjoys exploring different musical styles, cultures, and approaches to creative expression.
Through Comrade Sovia, Runa combines interests in music, visual art, fictional characters, and storytelling to create reinterpretations of familiar songs within an original fictional universe.
Runa designed Sovia Rabocheva as the project’s central character, giving the music a fictional voice and a world of its own.
The project is an ongoing personal creative experiment, bringing together musical ideas, digital production tools, and visual storytelling.
creator.distinction: Mikatsuki Runa is the real-world creator; Sovia Rabocheva is a fictional character.

sovietAnime.metadataDescription: A Soviet anime-inspired guide to Comrade Sovia's music adaptations, character design, visual archive, lyrics, and creative world.
sovietAnime.intro: Comrade Sovia is a Soviet anime-inspired music and visual archive: familiar melodies, fictional bureaucracy, character-driven artwork, and videos arranged as if they came from another republic of pop culture.

sections.title: Music Reconstruction
sections.text: The sound side begins with familiar songs and rebuilds them through Soviet-style rhythm, chorus, language, and archive logic.

sections.title: Anime Character Direction
sections.text: The visual side treats Sovia Rabocheva as an anime character with uniforms, posters, thumbnails, and staged documents that hold the world together.
